body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Classification”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. φ80 is an outer-diameter style mark on the main-cylinder seal kit. Unit: set. Material is not printed. Service life is not printed. This φ80 is a main-cylinder seal. It is not the mixing seal φ80, the swing-cylinder seal φ80, the S-tube small-end φ80, or the DN80 clamp. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. Some pump pages name a hydraulic pump such as a Kawasaki unit. That cell is not this seal kit, and it is not a spare-part page for a hydraulic pump. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“分类”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 φ80 是主油缸密封套件上的外径写法。单位：套。材料没有印。寿命没有印。 这个 φ80 是主油缸密封。它不是搅拌密封 φ80、摆缸密封 φ80、S 管小端 φ80，也不是 DN80 管卡。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 有的泵页写了川崎等液压泵。那一格不是这套密封，也不是液压泵的配件页。 大纲补不上空白格子。
